sam: Heads-up: Theo says ETA for our May H100 replenish moved from 2024-05-02 -> 2024-05-10. Were short 9 GPUs for EU dedicated pools next week.
rachel: rough. Which pools specifically?
diego: EU-dedicated-pool-1 and -2. That breaks a canary rollout and a nightly batch window. Throughput hit ~40% on embed-bulk.
Theo (GigaSupply): Confirmed on our side  forwarder flagged additional paperwork at FRA and slot congestion. Options: (A) air-expedite 5 units ETA 2024-05-05 at +$5k/unit, (B) split manifest with 4 units later 05-10, (C) offer up to 4 loaner H100s from demo pool for 10 days (no charge) but require temporary import docs.
sam: Can we take cross-region borrow from APAC for short term? Whats latency/cost tradeoff?
diego: Not for contracts with EU-data residency. For others egress + inter-region adds ~20-60ms and ~$0.08/token equivalence (rough). Not great for realtime routes.
rachel: Loaners sound tempting if paperwork is clean. Customs/duties risk?
Theo (GigaSupply): Loaners shipped as "temporary import" with ATA-style documentation. If declared correctly, no duties. We provide proforma, return AWB and 14-day RMA window. If customs forces assessment, vendor covers duties + reclamation.
inventory-bot: Inventory note: onboarding a loaner node requires: tag update, inventory reconcile, canary image push. Estimate ~90m per node including checks.
sam: Ops capacity: can we onboard 3 loaners within tonight's window?
diego: Yes, we have 3 canary slots free. 4 would overflow. 3 is safe.
Theo (GigaSupply): We can do expedite 5 units + 3 loaners. Remaining 1 unit stays on the 05-10 manifest. Expedite cost = $25k total. Loaners free but require signed LOI + serial tracking. AWBs and proforma ready once PO/LOI confirmed.
finance-bot: Finance view: need approval for $25k expedite (charge code INF-EXP-05). Please attach PO and cost center.
sam: Decision proposal: accept expedite 5 units, accept 3 loaners, hold last 1 on original manifest. Ops will onboard 3 loaners tonight during the 22:30 UTC window. Finance to approve the $25k.
rachel: +1 from product (avoids rollout rollback).
diego: I'll schedule canaries and patch node labels. Expect ~1.5h ops work tonight.
Theo (GigaSupply): Sending preliminary AWBs: EXP-UK-5501 (5 expedited), LOAN-UK-9910 (3 loaners), REM-UK-2200 (1 remaining). Proforma: https://files.gigasupply.example/proforma/3387654321 (DM access).
inventory-bot: Manifest snippet for intake:
```
SHIPMENT: EXP-UK-5501
ITEMS: 5x H100-RED-5000
SERIALS: pending
DEST: Redwood EU-Dedicated-1
ETA: 2024-05-05
```
finance-bot: Approved contingent on PO number and GL allocation. Please create PO INF-EXP-05-PO1.
sam: Creating PO now and pinging legal for loaner LOI. Theo, please DM LOI template.
Theo (GigaSupply): Will DM LOI + proforma. Updating carrier ETA live; I'll post final AWB once secured. :thumbsup:
sam: Thanks all  keep this thread for tracking.
